  (digits : Array Std.U32 8#usize) (addend : Std.U32) (i : Std.Usize) :

    let digits1 ← Array.update digits i i6
    let i7 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from aspis_core.field.P)
    let i8 ← sum / i7
    let addend1 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 i8)
    let i9 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize)
    ok (cont (digits1, addend1, i9))

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::host_sampler::gamma_sample]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/host_sampler.rs', lines 61:0-69:1
    Visibility: public -/
def host_sampler.gamma_sample
  (block : Array Std.U8 32#usize) :
  Result aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact
  := do
  let (digits, quotient) ← host_sampler.low_base_p_digits block
  let i ← lift (Std.U32.wrapping_add quotient 1#u32)
  let (wrapped, digits1) ← host_sampler.add_small_base_p digits i
  let digits2 ←
    if wrapped
    then
      do
      let (_, digits3) ← host_sampler.add_small_base_p digits1 1#u32
      ok digits3
    else ok digits1
  host_sampler.decode8 digits2
